lines: The sirens fade as state troopers swarm the dam.
But the captain looks at it, then looks at you.
"Put them in zip-ties. They are the prime suspect."

m1.text: They are in on it. The state governor is Ardis's brother.

m2.text: I can hack their cruiser's locking mechanism, but you have to align the frequency.

g1.text: Open the cloud to hack the cruiser lock.

mg1.title: Cruiser Override

config.brief: Match the police radio frequency to pop the locks.

hints: Adjust freq to 105 and amp to 75.

lines: You roll out into the muddy ditch as they look the other way.
